name: Vendor cameroncooke/reloaderoo
description: Wrap logMcp in reloaderoo's proxy mode. It adds a restart_server tool the agent calls to swap the child while the client stays connected, with crash limits. Restart is by tool, not automatic.

name: Vendor neilopet/mcpmon
description: Wrap logMcp in mcpmon, which restarts the server on every file change while the client stays connected. New tools still need a toggle in the client.

name: Vendor mizchi/mcp-reloader
description: Wrap logMcp in mcp-reloader, which re-imports files in a tools/ folder and sends list_changed, and restarts the whole process for other files matched by --include.

name: log's own reload proxy
description: logMcp becomes a small stable proxy in src/mcp/reload that owns the stdio pipe and runs the real server as a child. When codeStamp is newer and no call or job is running in the child, it starts a new child, replays the client's initialize, waits for it to answer, then sends tools/list_changed. It answers an error for any call caught mid-swap and kills the old child's process tree. logCall reaches tools added since.

name: In-process re-import
description: The server re-imports changed modules with cache-busting, with no process restart.
